faqs.question: What is Zoth Studio (zoth.nullai.tech)?
faqs.answer: Zoth Studio (https://zoth.nullai.tech) is the local studio from NullAI Tech. Start it with `npx @nullaitech/zoth studio` (localhost:3000). The package is `@nullaitech/zoth`. The ZothOS repo catalog dated 22 Oct 2026 lists 62 tools (45 browser workstations and 17 enclaves). That catalog is newer than the v3.2.0 ISO.

faqs.question: What is ZothOS Linux v3.2 (zothos.nullai.tech)?
faqs.answer: ZothOS Linux v3.2.0 (https://zothos.nullai.tech) is a Debian 13 (Trixie) live ISO with KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland and Debian’s stock Linux 6.12 kernel. Kali Rolling and Parrot Security are pinned at priority 400. About 75 security packages are curated. The published ISO (13 Oct 2026) is five parts plus zothos-join-iso.sh. A 152-entry MCP catalog ships disabled. Ollama can run locally if you pull models. There is no eBPF product claim in the OS README, and there is no published qcow2.
